LESSON: RE-USING WATER

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Caring for the 3.5 Caring for water By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners
Topic 3.5.2: Re-using water

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Re-using water. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. suggest how water could be re- used at home and school
2. participate in re-using water to reduce wastage at home and school
3. appreciate re-using water as a way of conserving it. community to find out how water is re-used to reduce wastage. could participate in re-using water to reduce wastage at home and school. 107 Core-competence to be development: Communication and collaboration: Groups sharing experiences, critical thinking and problem solving: water conservation. Links to PCIs: ESD: Environmental conservation, caring for water. Links to other learning activity areas (s): Hygiene and Nutrition: waste management Suggested community Service Learning activity: Excursion to the school neighbourhood to interact with the community to find out how they store water.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. suggest how water could be re- used at home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to suggest how water could be re- used at home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Re-using water.
2. Explain Re-using water to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Re-using water.
4. Show that you can: suggest how water could be re- used at home and school
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Re-using water. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Re-using water important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
